SELECT: g.display_name AS genre, t.primary_title AS movie_title, t.average_rating AS rating
FROM: titles t, titles_genres tg, genres g
WHERE: t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.num_votes > 10000 AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP_BY: g.id, g.display_name, t.id, t.primary_title, t.average_rating (用于窗口函数分区)
LIMIT: 通过 run_sql limit 参数控制，SQL 中不写 LIMIT
WINDOW: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.id ORDER BY t.average_rating DESC) AS rn，外层取 rn = 1
